## [1.0.4](https://github.com/Gagan-Pratap-S/GT-morphe-patches/compare/v1.0.3...v1.0.4) (2026-11-22)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **dialer:** use decode and document APIs to properly decode and re-encode AMOLED colors into ARSC ([295ec86](https://github.com/Gagan-Pratap-S/GT-morphe-patches/commit/295ec868a150db2ac345c92fbf1a6024665aac39))

patches.name: AMOLED Dark Theme
patches.description: Converts Google Phone dark theme from grey into pure pitch-black (#000000), enhances dialpad readability with pure white text, and fixes unsaved contact avatar outlines.

patches.name: Clone Dialer Package
patches.description: Changes package to com.google.android.dialer.amoled so non-rooted devices can install it without signature conflict.
